title: AI Adoption Audit
positioning_quote: “Technology is the engine of how MPLC grows. People are the fuel, AI is the turbocharger.” — A turbo needs an engine: this audit sequences AI behind the GTS rebuild, not beside it.
method_note: Built from public information only — MPLC sites and FAQs, published GTS job adverts, leadership profiles, association advisories and UK policy papers. Every current-state claim carries an evidence tag; every inference is labelled. Where evidence is thin, the finding is framed as a question, because that is how a BA hands work over.
why_now: MPLC has no visible AI initiatives in public — true greenfield. But greenfield into a rebuild is a different animal: GTS is being designed from the ground up under a new CIO while post-exit PE ownership sets the growth bar. AI can be designed into the Plan / Design & Build / Run pillars rather than retrofitted later at three times the cost. The published Analytics Engineer hire (Snowflake + dbt, “a number defined once, trusted by everyone”) shows leadership already knows the one precondition for useful AI: data foundations.
business_model: Blanket Licence: one annual fee, no reporting, unlimited covered showings in public/commercial spaces
Single Title Licence: application, returns form within 10 days, 5%/month late fee, audit rights
Tens of thousands of businesses — hotels, restaurants, surgeries, dealerships, offices — 40+ countries
Studios + independents (CNN/Turner renewal 2025, CNBC added 2026); MPLC collects and distributes
Education-first: association partnerships (FRLA), outreach to unlicensed venues, legal action as last resort
Customer initiates via support form quoting licence/invoice number
~250 staff, 21% sales; GTS = all technology under CIO, three pillars

ratings.evidence: Snowflake + dbt, Analytics Engineer reporting to CIO; ad language explicitly targets “future AI-driven capabilities”
Salesforce operated via Run pillar; Pardot; NetSuite + Sage Intacct; named Revenue Ops team
Renewal is customer-initiated via support form — friction inside a “zero hassle, one annual fee” product; no proactive renewal evidence
Education-first outreach and association partnerships; correspondence-heavy across 40+ countries; no monitoring-tech signals
Forms + email across country sites; highly repetitive coverage questions answered publicly in FAQs
Royalty machinery implied (ERP stack present; Tenzing case study notes research into data sources for royalty calculation)
Published targets: service catalogue, MSP to spec, “joiners/movers/leavers… increasingly automated” — aspiration, not finished state
Nothing public. Which also means shadow AI is already happening informally; formalising it is the cheapest early win

strategic.title: The strategic twist — AI as a product, not just a cost line
strategic.body: The House of Lords Communications and Digital Committee report (HL Paper 267, Feb 2026) and the Data (Use and Access) Act obligations (Mar 2026) point the UK toward a licensing-first model for training AI on copyrighted works. MPLC already holds what that market needs: a title-level rights registry, decades of studio relationships and collective-licensing machinery. Question to test with GTS: are the rightsholders already asking? If yes, the same data foundations being built for internal efficiency are a future revenue platform — exhibition licensing was the 20th-century version; AI-training rights is the 21st-century one.

opportunities.title: Support triage + agent assist
opportunities.detail: LLM pre-triage of inbound licensing questions; drafts grounded in MPLC licence docs and country FAQs
opportunities.boundary: Nothing legal leaves unapproved; every draft cites its source document

opportunities.title: Renewal desk
opportunities.detail: MPLC-initiated, segmented, personalised annual renewal packs with human sign-off
opportunities.boundary: Human approval on outbound; studio relationships never automated

opportunities.title: Rights-coverage lookup (staff-first)
opportunities.detail: Assistant over the title/territory registry answering “is this covered here?” before any public exposure
opportunities.boundary: Read-only; legal workflow signs off before external use
opportunities.measure: Answers per hour, error rate vs registry

opportunities.title: Joiners/movers/leavers automation
opportunities.detail: Make the published Run aspiration real: one end-to-end HR process, automated with gates
opportunities.measure: Days to full access, tickets per starter

opportunities.title: Enforcement lead triage
opportunities.detail: Score outreach targets, summarise field reports into a risk-ordered queue
opportunities.boundary: Never auto-accusation — fines cited run to $150k per work; humans investigate and decide; bias-check by sector
opportunities.measure: Leads worked per week, conversion to licensed

opportunities.title: Single Title returns reconciliation
opportunities.detail: OCR + extraction on returns forms vs screening records; flag non-returns inside the 10-day window
opportunities.boundary: Fee decisions stay human; audit rights are legal instruments

opportunities.title: Renewal forecasting + pipeline enrichment
opportunities.detail: Which accounts lapse, which association-verticals convert best (FRLA model repeatable)
opportunities.boundary: Sales owns the relationship; AI owns the shortlist

opportunities.title: Self-service analytics on Snowflake
opportunities.detail: Text-to-SQL for defined metrics for Finance/RevOps
opportunities.boundary: Defined-once metrics only — no re-derived numbers

opportunities.title: AI-training rights licensing
opportunities.detail: Extend the registry and licensing machinery into rights for AI training data
opportunities.boundary: Rightsholder consent is the product — nothing ships without it

governance: One-page policy: approved tools, approved data, what never enters a model (rightsholder terms, licensee personal data, enforcement case files)
Human sign-off as default for anything leaving the building — the same “run gate” discipline GTS already publishes
Spend metered from day one: caps, monthly review — cost creep is the most predictable AI failure mode
Vendor/model register with an exit note per entry
GDPR across 40+ territories; EU AI Act care wherever firms or people are scored
No use case launches without a before-number — automation with receipts

first90.body: Process-owner interviews across Licensing, Enforcement, Finance, RevOps; sit the support queue; read the licence corpus; output a use-case register scored impact/effort/risk
Two instrumented pilots from the Now list with agreed baselines; governance v1 ratified; prototypes built personally — a live pilot beats a plan slide
First automation in production with published before/after numbers; register becomes Plan's rolling quarterly roadmap; live items handed into Design & Build and Run

risks: Transformation stacking — GTS is being rebuilt, staffed and AI-enabled at once; one quiet win per quarter beats five stalled pilots
Shadow AI — already happening; formalise rather than ban
Legal-risk automation creep — anything resembling accusation stays human-decided
AI theatre — demos that never reach production; spend meter + baseline discipline is the vaccine
Data before dashboards — protect the defined-once-metric culture from projects that re-derive numbers
